Frequently Asked Questions About Junk Cleanout Services in Richmond Hill, ON

items.q: Q: What do cleanout services cost in Richmond Hill?
a: A: Volume alone sets it — small jobs from $125, basements and garages mid-range, whole homes as one flat multi-load figure quoted at the free walkthrough. Approved prices are final regardless of what the space reveals or how long the work runs.

items.q: Q: The contractor starts Monday — can the basement be empty by then?
a: A: That’s precisely the deadline work we’re built for. Tell us the demo date and we’ll clear to bare walls ahead of it — furniture, storage, the closet nobody’s opened — with the schedule treated as a promise, not a target. Most pre-reno clears finish in a single visit.

items.q: Q: The new design has no place for our old furniture. Can you take it during the reno?
a: A: Displaced furniture is half the renovation story and a standard part of our pickups. The old sectional, the extra dressers, the dining set that doesn’t fit the open concept — all of it rides out in one volume-priced load, and the usable pieces go to donation first.

items.q: Q: Can you also take what the trades leave behind when the project wraps?
a: A: Gladly — post-reno leftovers are their own category with us: offcuts, packaging, retired fixtures, the corner pile everyone stopped seeing. One pickup closes out the project properly.

items.q: Q: We're selling a home the family has owned since it was built. How does that cleanout work?
a: A: With patience and a sorting-first approach. Original-owner homes hold thirty years of layers, so we clear room by room, set aside documents, photos and valuables for the family, route the usable to donation, and leave every room swept for the listing photos. Most finish within a day.
